expressionLevels.name: Minimal
expressionLevels.tagline: Tiny, discreet, tonal or restrained embroidery.
expressionLevels.description: Quiet luxury worn close to the chest. Intimate threadwork, tonal crests, and understated accents noticed only by the discerning.

expressionLevels.name: Subtle Statements
expressionLevels.tagline: Small but noticeable motifs, refined placement.
expressionLevels.description: Refined focal points that invite conversation without overwhelming. Thoughtfully placed emblems on pockets, cuffs, and hemlines.
expressionLevels.characteristics: Small motifs, single placement, refined contrast

expressionLevels.name: Artistic
expressionLevels.tagline: Medium compositions, illustrative designs and multiple elements.
expressionLevels.description: Balancing wearable elegance with narrative needlecraft. Multi-element compositions with rich thread textures and measured storytelling.
expressionLevels.characteristics: Medium coverage, illustrative, dual elements, harmonic contrast

expressionLevels.name: Bold Statements
expressionLevels.tagline: Large artwork, prominent contrast or multiple placements.
expressionLevels.description: Commanding apparel with undeniable presence. Broad panels, vibrant bullion contrast, and expressive artwork designed to turn heads.
expressionLevels.characteristics: Large artwork, high contrast, multiple placements, expressive

expressionLevels.name: Elaborate & Intricate
expressionLevels.tagline: Dense compositions, complex motifs or extensive threadwork.
expressionLevels.description: Museum-grade couture needlework. 30 to 60+ artisan hours of continuous hand-zardozi, bullion wire, and multi-layered relief across full panels.
expressionLevels.characteristics: Dense threadwork, maximum relief, full panels, master craft
